div.div: Four AI agents watching different failure surfaces of TTAG — named after the hundred-eyed watchman.

tr.td: Traces row-count mismatches, duplicate keys, NULL FK joins, watermark gaps
Classifies DLQ records, auto-requeues transients, escalates with context
Queries watermarks + Iceberg snapshots → safe backfill plan with HITL approval
Analyzes SparkUI metrics, execution plans → surfaces skew, spills, GC issues

ul.li: Each agent: LangGraph StateGraph with typed Pydantic state + structured output
Multi-trigger: Airflow on_failure_callback · CLI · REST API
P1 → PagerDuty · P2 → Slack · P3 → log only
